name: Implenia AG
summary: Implenia AG provides construction and real estate services in Switzerland, Germany, Austria, Norway, Sweden, France, and internationally. It operates through Buildings; Civil Engineering; and Service Solutions segments. The company engages in tunnel construction; civil engineering; structural engineering; foundation engineering; structural design; building preservation; and depots. It also engages in construction maintenance; works yards; building construction logistics; and bar post-tensioning systems services, as well as solutions for excavations, retaining structures, deep foundations, and noise barriers.
